notes.title: Tram Simulator Urban Transit now also for consoles and additional PC platforms
notes.content:

notes.title: Tram Simulator Urban Transit – Update #2 available for download!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720910/8d9b06f70d1f8d54a4d84151d878b5876b10c398.png[/img]

We just released [b]Update #2[/b] for [b]Tram Simulator Urban Transit[/b] on Steam. The update fixes some bugs and issues reported by the community and introduces a set of additional interior skins for your trams. Here are the detailed patch notes:

[b]Patchnotes – Update #2[/b]

[b]Additional interior skins:[/b]
[list]
[*] 11 new Interior skins for customization
[/list]

[b]Tram Related Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed S4D2x22 I G18 the camera in the rear wagon was moving while driving the tram
[*] Fixed the route LEDs not matching the display curve of some trams
[*] Fixed trams continue to drive and ramping up speed after the engine has been turned off
[*] Fixed tram wheelchair ramp extends under the terrain or at a right angle
[*] Fixed displays "Cam 1" and "Cam 2" are not located inside the cockpit on the "2Cities - T01" tram
[/list]

[b]Others:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bus icon next to a tram's name in Tram Depot
[*] Fixed in Tram Dealership navigating to the right via "RB" button skips "Adok's"
[*] Fixed when using controller, the time can only be changed by two on the map menu
[*] Fixed passenger gets stuck during "Route info event"
[*] Fixed when leaving the tram, the HUD still shows tram status icons at the top
[*] Fixed Tram with Al driver continues the route with turned on warning lights and emergency brake.
[*] Fixed garage button displays as locked after completing the first mission
[*] Fixed lobby settings are not locked until mission 2
[*] Fixed rain streams apply to the tram models inside the garage and under the roof during the rainy weather
[*] Some smaller fixes and game improvements
[/list]


Your Tram Simulator team

notes.title: Tram Simulator Urban Transit now available on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720910/21da7002660555268fab20ba54aecf13ecd9fb99.jpg[/img]

Today are happy to celebrate the release of [b]Tram Simulator Urban Transit[/b]. The new simulation game is now available for PC on Steam. 

[previewyoutube=jffQ46eaVFA;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Tram Simulator Urban Transit:[/b]
[list]
[*] 6 playable tram models - including a detailed, interactive cockpit!
[*] More than 10 missions in story mode
[*] Extensive rail network
[*] Create your own tram lines and timetables
[*] Road traffic interacts with trams
[*] Various random events during the rides
[*] Dedicated tram depots for the trams
[*] Driving school for beginners!
[*] 3 game modes: Story, Career and Sandbox
[*] Multiplayer for up to 4 players
[*] Now available at a price of 19,99 EUR / 19.99 USD (SRP) for PC on Steam!
[*] Dedicated versions for PlayStation®5, PlayStation®4, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One and PC on the Epic Games Store and the Microsoft Store are planned for spring 2024!
[*] Owners of astragon’s Bus Simulator 21 Next Stop - Official Tram Extension or Bus Simulator 21 Next Stop - Season Pass will automatically receive free access to Tram Simulator Urban Transit!
[*] Buyers of Tram Simulator Urban Transit receive free access to Bus Simulator 21 Next Stop - Official Tram Extension (main game required to play)!
[/list]

[b]Tram Simulator Urban Transit[/b] gives streetcar fans the opportunity to set up their own public transport company in the fictitious US metropolis of Angel Shores. The game offers players 6 drivable streetcars - three different models, each in two different lengths - including detailed and interactive cockpits. In addition to being able to define and drive your own routes, you can also control your passengers' tickets. Of course, players should also keep an eye on the traffic and the numerous random events that await them during their journeys!

In [b]Tram Simulator Urban Transit[/b], players have three different game modes to choose from: In Story mode, there are more than 10 challenging missions to master as part of the exciting campaign. In Career mode, players can start their tram company without any guidelines and expand it according to their wishes - due to the low starting capital, it is of course important to manage well while trying to lead the company to success. In Sandbox mode, meanwhile, streetcar fans can create their company without any limits - everything is unlocked directly and players have unlimited funds at their disposal, so they can develop completely freely right from the start. All three game modes can of course also be played in multiplayer with up to three additional players.

[b]Tram Simulator Urban Transit[/b] is now available at a price of 19.99 EUR / 19.99 USD (SRP) for PC on Steam. Dedicated versions for PlayStation®5, PlayStation®4, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One and for PC on the Epic Games Store and the Microsoft Store are planned for spring 2024.

Owners of astragon’s [b]Bus Simulator 21 Next Stop - Official Tram Extension[/b] or the [b]Bus Simulator 21 Next Stop - Season Pass[/b] automatically receive [b]free access to Tram Simulator Urban Transit[/b]! Conversely, buyers of [b]Tram Simulator Urban Transit[/b] receive free access to [b]Bus Simulator 21 Next Stop - Official Tram Extension[/b] (main game required to play)!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2546690/

notes.title: Tram Simulator Urban Transit to be released on December 05, 2023!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720910/21da7002660555268fab20ba54aecf13ecd9fb99.jpg[/img]

Today, we are pleased to announce the official release date for Tram Simulator Urban Transit. The brand-new tram simulator will be released on December 05, 2023 for PC on Steam!

[b]Tram Simulator Urban Transit:[/b]
[list]
[*] 6 playable tram models - including a detailed, interactive cockpit!
[*] More than 10 missions in story mode
[*] Extensive rail network
[*] Create your own tram lines and timetables
[*] Road traffic interacts with trams
[*] Various random events during the rides
[*] Dedicated tram depots for the trams
[*] Driving school for beginners!
[*] Multiplayer for up to 4 players
[*] To be released on December 05, 2023 at a price of 19,99 EUR / 19.99 USD (SRP) for PC on Steam - available for pre-order now!
[*] Dedicated versions for PlayStation®5, PlayStation®4, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One and PC on the Epic Games Store will follow in spring 2024!
[*] Owners of astragon’s Bus Simulator 21 Next Stop - Official Tram Extension or Bus Simulator 21 Next Stop - Season Pass will automatically receive free access to Tram Simulator Urban Transit on its release!
[*] Buyers of Tram Simulator Urban Transit will receive free access to Bus Simulator 21 Next Stop - Official Tram Extension (main game required to play)!
[/list]

[b]Tram Simulator Urban Transit[/b] gives the opportunity to set up your own public transport company in the fictitious US metropolis of Angel Shores. In the game, you not only have 6 drivable streetcar models including detailed and interactive cockpits at your disposal - the tram lines can also be created independently, based on the extensive rail network and the stops distributed throughout the city while the timetables can be configured as required.

For beginners the game offers dedicated driving school missions, which will introduce you step by step on how to control the trams and explain in detail what you need to consider as a streetcar driver in Angel Shores.

Be it in single or multiplayer mode with up to three additional players, there is always plenty of variety while expanding your own local transport company. In addition to being able to define your own routes and to drive them with the tram of your choice, you can of course also check passenger’s tickets, and have to keep an eye on the traffic as well as the numerous random events waiting for you!

In addition to the story mode with more than 10 missions, there are also two other game modes to choose from. In sandbox mode, you get unlimited money and all trams and districts are unlocked right from the start, so you can try things out as you wish. In career mode, all trams and districts are also accessible directly, but here you have to manage your starting money well while leading your company to success - completely freely and according to your own preferences!

[b]Tram Simulator Urban Transit[/b] will be released for PC on Steam on December 5, 2023 at a price of 19.99 EUR / 19.99 USD (SRP) and is now available for pre-order.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2546690/

Owners of astragon’s [b]Bus Simulator 21 Next Stop - Official Tram Extension[/b] or the [b]Bus Simulator 21 Next Stop - Season Pass[/b] will automatically receive free access to [b]Tram Simulator Urban Transit[/b] as soon as the game got released! Conversely, buyers of [b]Tram Simulator Urban Transit[/b] will receive free access to [b]Bus Simulator 21 Next Stop - Official Tram Extension[/b] (main game required to play)!

Your Tram Simulator team
